lastSummary: NC-018 fixed: Batch edits are sequential and non-transactional. (1) Pre-validation phase: all edit paths are resolved and checked for duplicates/traversal BEFORE any writes. If pre-validation fails, the entire batch is rejected with no side effects. (2) Atomic writes: all create and update operations now use atomicWriteFile() (temp-file + rename) instead of direct fs.writeFile(), preventing truncation on crash. (3) Rollback on failure: before each edit, original state is captured (file content for update, existence for create, content for delete). If any edit fails, all prior edits are rolled back in reverse order. (4) Early termination: once an edit fails, no further edits are attempted. (5) Removed dead executeBatchEditItem() method — logic is now in the transactional batch_edit handler. (6) 20 new regression tests in batchEditTransactional.test.ts: pre-validation duplicate paths (4 tests), pre-validation traversal (3 tests), rollback create/update/delete (3 tests), rollback multiple edits reverse order (1 test), rollback count reporting (1 test), early termination (1 test), unknown operation rollback (1 test), atomic writes (2 tests), mixed-operation batches (2 tests), no partial modifications (2 tests), edge cases (3 tests). 1066/1066 unit tests pass. Build clean. All type-checks clean.
